notes.title: Arcadia Fallen II ✖ Gamescom 2025
notes.content: [p]We’re finally able to announce that we’re taking Arcadia Fallen II to Gamescom in August as part of the Indie Arena Booth! We are so excited to go to Cologne again. Last time, we were there to share Arcadia Fallen in 2022 (OMG where did the time go? xD). We had such a great time, and we’re looking forward to chatting with gamers and developers alike again.[/p][p]For us, the Indie Arena Booth is the gem of Gamescom and we’re so proud to be part of their lineup, just look at all these cool games! [/p][p][url="https://indiearenabooth.de/gamescom2025/games"]https://indiearenabooth.de/gamescom2025/games[/url][/p][p]There’s also gonna be an online exhibition for the folks who can’t be there in person, so we hope you’ll check it out and support all these awesome indie developers! 🤗[/p][p]Daniel from Galdra Studios[/p]

notes.title: A.J. Beckles as Elias
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882034/f4722ec4caf8ac88e3897e278e9366acd270b964.png[/img]

Arcadia Fallen II is now 300% funded on Kickstarter and we're well on our way to secure even more voice acting in the game, including more lines for Elias who is voiced by the charming A.J. Beckles!

[i]One of the most accomplished Mender students at the Academy, Elias is famed for his bedside manner and his sharp style. He can go from deadly serious to dangerously flirtatious in an instant, so tread carefully. There’s a secret hidden behind that capable smile, but he doesn’t want anyone to get close enough to uncover it. Will you be the one to mend his conflicted heart? He is one of five potential love interests in Arcadia Fallen II[/i]

[quote=A.J. Beckles]LETS GO!!!

I Play ELIAS in ARCADIA FALLEN 2

This was so much fun to get to work on. Shoutout to the team for being so kind and Philip Bache for letting me have fun with his direction.

[i]—A.J. Beckles[/i][/quote]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/galdra/arcadia-fallen-2]Join the adventure![/url]

Cheers,
The Galdra Team

notes.title: Brenna Larsen as Hannah
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/galdra/arcadia-fallen-2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882034/756059a33edb2757c0418e6ae5de2f1de145f38a.png[/img][/url]

[i]Hannah dreams of performing at Mordressa’s opera house, wowing the people of the Central Capital with her beautiful, magical voice. She’s not the only one with this dream, so she’s spent the last six years channeling her energy into studying and practice. Her dream is in reach, but her energy is nearly spent. Will you be her muse, or just a bad influence? She is one of five potential love interests in Arcadia Fallen II[/i]

Brenna Larsen voices Hannah, the stressed-out Illusionist, and she also performs the vocals for our title song Stepping Stones. If the campaign goes well, hopefully, we’ll get to hear more of her beautiful singing in the game.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/galdra/arcadia-fallen-2]Join the adventure![/url]

Cheers,
The Galdra Team

notes.title: Arcadia Fallen II Demo Release
notes.content:
store.steampowered.com/app/3013660/

Hi everyone!

The very first demo for Arcadia Fallen II is now LIVE!

Play the first chapter of this brand new adventure at the Seven Winds Academy. Meet all the new characters, including the four new love interests. You’ll even get to hear their voices!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882034/39458d790d193246cd5283a74c5db6980b47124d.gif[/img]

Explore the school using the travel-map. There’s so many fun new places to discover, you might even find a cat hiding somewhere!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882034/01350e1213c1ce18676eb54586b466a56215039d.gif[/img]

And there's a character creator as well! The options are limited since we're still working on assets, but the full game will have at least the same amount of customization as our first game! And as something unique for this game you'll get to choose your roommate and class major!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882034/cdb07ac9f9fdc1bec8c93cdaeecdb69106305217.gif[/img]

We've put a lot of work and love into this demo and we hope you'll all have a fun time playing! Please be sure to leave any feedback you might have in the discussion forum as well. We’d love to hear what you think!^^

See you all in the next update!

Cheers~

The Galdra Team
